2. Stir in baking powder (and diced fruit).

3. Heat a lightly oiled griddle to medium low.

4. Pour batter onto the heated surface, making small 3-inch (7.5 cm)
pancakes (to make them easier to flip). When the pancakes are golden
on the bottom, flip them over and cook on the other side.

5. Optional: Top with the cooked peaches and enjoy!

Yield: 1 hearty breakfast of 6 3-inch (7.5 cm) pancakes

NUTRITION INFORMATION: 450 total calories (without fruit topping); 50 g carbohydrate; 32
g protein; 14 g fat
